name: Adeka Corporation
summary: Adeka Corporation engages in chemicals, food, and life sciences businesses. The company offers polymer additives, such as antioxidants, UV absorbers/hindered amine light stabilizers, nucleating agents/clarifying agents, metal deactivators/additives for filled polymers, flame retardants, epoxy type stabilizers/processability improvers/lubricants/water dispersion type stabilizers; plasticizers/PVC stabilizers; and photo/thermal curing materials, initiators, polymer materials, resist materials, thermal paper materials, semiconductor materials, circuit formation, and resin materials.
